segments.sn35.116:1.1: “Nāhaṃ, bhikkhave, gamanena lokassa antaṃ ñāteyyaṃ, daṭṭheyyaṃ [diṭṭheyyaṃ (syā. kaṃ. ka.)], patteyyanti vadāmi.
segments.sn35.116:1.2: Na ca panāhaṃ, bhikkhave, appatvā lokassa antaṃ dukkhassa antakiriyaṃ vadāmī”ti.
segments.sn35.116:1.3: Idaṃ vatvā bhagavā uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ pāvisi.
segments.sn35.116:1.4: Atha kho tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ acirapakkantassa bhagavato etadahosi –
segments.sn35.116:1.5: “idaṃ kho no, āvuso, bhagavā saṃkhittena uddesaṃ uddisitvā vitthārena atthaṃ avibhajitvā uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ paviṭṭho –
segments.sn35.116:1.6: ‘nāhaṃ, bhikkhave, gamanena lokassa antaṃ ñāteyyaṃ, daṭṭheyyaṃ, patteyyanti vadāmi.
segments.sn35.116:1.7: Na ca panāhaṃ, bhikkhave, appatvā lokassa antaṃ dukkhassa antakiriyaṃ vadāmī’ti.
segments.sn35.116:1.8: Ko nu kho imassa bhagavatā saṃkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena atthaṃ avibhattassa vitthārena atthaṃ vibhajeyyā”ti?
segments.sn35.116:2.2: “ayaṃ kho āyasmā ānando satthu ceva saṃvaṇṇito, sambhāvito ca viññūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ.
segments.sn35.116:2.3: Pahoti cāyasmā ānando imassa bhagavatā saṃkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena atthaṃ avibhattassa vitthārena atthaṃ vibhajituṃ.
segments.sn35.116:2.4: Yaṃnūna mayaṃ yenāyasmā ānando tenupasaṅkameyyāma; upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etamatthaṃ paṭipuccheyyāmā”ti.
segments.sn35.116:3.1: Atha kho te bhikkhū yenāyasmā ānando tenupasaṅkamiṃsu; upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā ānandena saddhiṃ sammodiṃsu.
segments.sn35.116:3.2: Sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. Ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavocuṃ –
segments.sn35.116:4.1: “Idaṃ kho no, āvuso ānanda, bhagavā saṃkhittena uddesaṃ uddisitvā vitthārena atthaṃ avibhajitvā uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ paviṭṭho –
segments.sn35.116:4.2: ‘nāhaṃ, bhikkhave, gamanena lokassa antaṃ ñāteyyaṃ, daṭṭheyyaṃ, patteyyanti vadāmi.
segments.sn35.116:4.3: Na ca panāhaṃ, bhikkhave, appatvā lokassa antaṃ dukkhassa antakiriyaṃ vadāmī’ti.
segments.sn35.116:4.4: Tesaṃ no, āvuso, amhākaṃ acirapakkantassa bhagavato etadahosi –
segments.sn35.116:4.5: ‘idaṃ kho no, āvuso, bhagavā saṃkhittena uddesaṃ uddisitvā vitthārena atthaṃ avibhajitvā uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ paviṭṭho –
segments.sn35.116:4.6: nāhaṃ, bhikkhave, gamanena lokassa antaṃ ñāteyyaṃ, daṭṭheyyaṃ, patteyyanti vadāmi.
segments.sn35.116:4.7: Na ca panāhaṃ, bhikkhave, appatvā lokassa antaṃ dukkhassa antakiriyaṃ vadāmīti.
segments.sn35.116:4.8: Ko nu kho imassa bhagavatā saṃkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena atthaṃ avibhattassa vitthārena atthaṃ vibhajeyyā’ti?
segments.sn35.116:4.10: ‘ayaṃ kho, āvuso, āyasmā ānando satthu ceva saṃvaṇṇito, sambhāvito ca viññūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ.
segments.sn35.116:4.11: Pahoti cāyasmā ānando imassa bhagavatā saṃkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena atthaṃ avibhattassa vitthārena atthaṃ vibhajituṃ.
segments.sn35.116:4.12: Yaṃnūna mayaṃ yenāyasmā ānando tenupasaṅkameyyāma; upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etamatthaṃ paṭipuccheyyāmā’ti.
segments.sn35.116:5.1: “Seyyathāpi, āvuso, puriso sāratthiko sāragavesī sārapariyesanaṃ caramāno mahato rukkhassa tiṭṭhato sāravato atikkammeva, mūlaṃ atikkammeva, khandhaṃ sākhāpalāse sāraṃ pariyesitabbaṃ maññeyya;
segments.sn35.116:5.2: evaṃ sampadamidaṃ āyasmantānaṃ satthari sammukhībhūte taṃ bhagavantaṃ atisitvā amhe etamatthaṃ paṭipucchitabbaṃ maññatha [maññetha (pī. ka.)].
segments.sn35.116:5.3: So hāvuso, bhagavā jānaṃ jānāti, passaṃ passati –
segments.sn35.116:5.4: cakkhubhūto, ñāṇabhūto, dhammabhūto, brahmabhūto, vattā, pavattā, atthassa ninnetā, amatassa dātā, dhammassāmī, tathāgato.
segments.sn35.116:5.5: So ceva panetassa kālo ahosi yaṃ bhagavantaṃyeva etamatthaṃ paṭipuccheyyātha.
segments.sn35.116:5.6: Yathā vo bhagavā byākareyya tathā vo dhāreyyāthā”ti.
segments.sn35.116:6.1: “Addhāvuso ānanda, bhagavā jānaṃ jānāti, passaṃ passati –
segments.sn35.116:6.2: cakkhubhūto, ñāṇabhūto, dhammabhūto, brahmabhūto, vattā, pavattā, atthassa ninnetā, amatassa dātā, dhammassāmī, tathāgato.
segments.sn35.116:6.3: So ceva panetassa kālo ahosi yaṃ bhagavantaṃyeva etamatthaṃ paṭipuccheyyāma.

segments.sn35.116:7.2: “Evamāvuso”ti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato ānandassa paccassosuṃ.
segments.sn35.116:8.1: “Yaṃ kho vo, āvuso, bhagavā saṃkhittena uddesaṃ uddisitvā vitthārena atthaṃ avibhajitvā uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ paviṭṭho –

segments.sn35.116:8.21: Yathā vo bhagavā byākaroti tathā naṃ dhāreyyāthā”ti.

segments.sn35.116:10.11: Pahoti cāyasmā ānando imassa bhagavatā saṃkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena atthaṃ avibhattassa vitthārena atthaṃ vibhajituṃ.
segments.sn35.116:10.12: Yaṃnūna mayaṃ yenāyasmā ānando tenupasaṅkameyyāma; upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etamatthaṃ paṭipuccheyyāmā’ti.
segments.sn35.116:10.13: Atha kho mayaṃ, bhante, yenāyasmā ānando tenupasaṅkamimha; upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etamatthaṃ paṭipucchimha.
segments.sn35.116:10.14: Tesaṃ no, bhante, āyasmatā ānandena imehi ākārehi imehi padehi imehi byañjanehi attho vibhatto”ti.
segments.sn35.116:11.2: Maṃ cepi tumhe, bhikkhave, etamatthaṃ paṭipuccheyyātha, ahampi taṃ evamevaṃ byākareyyaṃ yathā taṃ ānandena byākataṃ.
segments.sn35.116:11.3: Eso cevetassa attho, evañca naṃ dhāreyyāthā”ti.

lines: Vihāraṃ pāvisīti “mayi vihāraṃ paviṭṭhe ime bhikkhū, imaṃ uddesaṃ ānandaṃ pucchissanti, so ca tesaṃ mama sabbaññutaññāṇena saṃsanditvā kathessati.

Tato naṃ thomessāmi, mama thomanaṃ sutvā bhikkhū ānandaṃ upasaṅkamitabbaṃ, vacanañcassa sotabbaṃ saddhātabbaṃ maññissanti, taṃ nesaṃ bhavissati dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāyā”ti cintetvā saṃkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena atthaṃ avibhajitvāva nisinnāsane antarahito gandhakuṭiyaṃ pāturahosi.
Viññūnanti idampi karaṇatthe sāmivacanaṃ, paṇḍitehi sabrahmacārīhi ca sambhāvitoti attho.
Atikkammeva mūlaṃ atikkammeva khandhanti sāro nāma mūle vā khandhe vā bhaveyya, tampi atikkamitvāti attho.
Yathā vā ekacco viparītaṃ gaṇhanto jānantopi na jānāti, passantopi na passati, na evaṃ bhagavā.
Bhagavā pana jānanto jānāti, passanto passatiyeva.
Aviparītasabhāvaṭṭhena pariyattidhammapavattanato vā hadayena cintetvā vācāya nicchāritadhammamayoti dhammabhūto.
Atha vā cakkhu viya bhūtoti cakkhubhūto.
Agaruṃ karitvāti punappunaṃ yācāpentopi hi garuṃ karoti nāma.
Attano sekkhapaṭisambhidāñāṇe ṭhatvā sinerupādato vālikaṃ uddharamāno viya dubbiññeyyaṃ katvā kathentopi garuṃ karotiyeva nāma.
Evaṃ akatvā amhe punappunaṃ ayācāpetvā suviññeyyampi no katvā kathehīti vuttaṃ hoti.
Cakkhunā kho, āvuso, lokasmiṃ lokasaññī hoti lokamānīti cakkhuñhi loke appahīnadiṭṭhi puthujjano sattalokavasena lokoti sañjānāti ceva maññati ca, tathā cakkavāḷalokavasena.
Na hi aññatra cakkhādīhi dvādasāyatanehi tassa sā saññā vā māno vā uppajjati.
Tena vuttaṃ, “cakkhunā kho, āvuso, lokasmiṃ lokasaññī hoti lokamānī”ti.
Imassa ca lokassa gamanena anto nāma ñātuṃ vā daṭṭhuṃ vā pattuṃ vā na sakkā.
Lujjanaṭṭhena pana tasseva cakkhādibhedassa lokassa nibbānasaṅkhātaṃ antaṃ appatvā vaṭṭadukkhassa antakiriyā nāma natthīti veditabbā.
Evaṃ pañhaṃ vissajjetvā idāni “sāvakena pañho kathitoti mā nikkaṅkhā ahuvattha, ayaṃ bhagavā sabbaññutaññāṇatulaṃ gahetvā nisinno.
Icchamānā tameva upasaṅkamitvā nikkaṅkhā hothā”ti uyyojento ākaṅkhamānā panātiādimāha.
Imehi ākārehīti imehi kāraṇehi cakkavāḷalokassa antābhāvakāraṇehi ceva saṅkhāralokassa antāpattikāraṇehi ca.
Catūhi kāraṇehi paṇḍito dhātukusalo āyatanakusalo paccayākārakusalo kāraṇākāraṇakusaloti.
Mahāpaññoti mahante atthe mahante dhamme mahantā niruttiyo mahantāni paṭibhānāni paṭiggaṇhanasamatthatāya mahāpaññāya samannāgato.
Yathā taṃ ānandenāti yathā ānandena byākataṃ, taṃ sandhāya vuttaṃ.
Yathā ānandena taṃ byākataṃ, ahampi taṃ evameva byākareyyanti attho. 4.

lines: Na hi padesaññāṇe ṭhito jānitabbaṃ sabbaṃ jānāti.
Ukkaṭṭhaniddesena hi avisesaggahaṇena ca “jāna”nti iminā niravasesaṃ ñeyyajātaṃ pariggayhatīti tabbisayāya jānanakiriyāya sabbaññutaññāṇameva karaṇaṃ bhavituṃ yuttaṃ.
Atha vā jānaṃ jānātīti yathā aññe savipallāsā kāmarūpapariññāvādino jānantāpi vipallāsavasena jānanti, na evaṃ bhagavā.
Bhagavā pana pahīnavipallāsattā jānanto jānāti eva, diṭṭhidassanassa abhāvā passanto passati evāti attho.

Dassanapariṇāyakaṭṭhenāti yathā cakkhu sattānaṃ dassanatthaṃ pariṇeti sādheti, evaṃ lokassa yāthāvadassanasādhanatopi dassanakiccapariṇāyakaṭṭhena cakkhubhūto, paññācakkhumayattā vā sayambhūñāṇena paññācakkhuṃ bhūto pattoti vā cakkhubhūto.
Dhammā vā bodhipakkhiyā, tehi uppannattā lokassa ca taduppādanato anaññasādhāraṇaṃ vā dhammaṃ patto adhigatoti dhammabhūto.
“Brahmā”vuccati seṭṭhaṭṭhena maggañāṇaṃ, tena uppannattā lokassa ca taduppādanato tañca sayambhūñāṇena pattoti brahmabhūto.
Amatasacchikiriyaṃ sattesu uppādento amataṃ dadātīti amatassa dātā.
Punappunaṃ yācāpento bhāriyaṃ karonto garuṃ karoti nāma, tathā duviññeyyaṃ katvā kathentopi.
Appahīnadiṭṭhīti asamūhatasakkāyadiṭṭhiko ghanavinibbhogaṃ kātuṃ asakkonto samudāyaṃ viya avayavaṃ “loko”ti sañjānāti ceva maññati ca.
Tathāti iminā “lokoti sañjānāti ceva maññati cā”ti padattayaṃ ākaḍḍhati.
Cakkavāḷalokassa pana anto nāma, natthi tassa gamanena appattabbattā.
Pāṭiyekkaakkharehīti tasmiṃ tasmiṃ pade paṭiniyatasannivesehi visuṃ visuṃ cittena gayhamānehi akkharehīti attho.
Gamanaṭṭhena “paṇḍā” vuccati paññā, tāya ito gato pattoti paṇḍito, paññavā.
Mahāpaññatā nāma paṭisambhidāvasena veditabbāti āha “mahante atthe”tiādi.
Yathā tanti ettha tanti nipātamattaṃ paṭhamavikappe, dutiyavikappe pana paccāmasananti āha “taṃ byākata”nti.
